cleavage_agent.evidence: The BAG3-FLAG protein bands were cut out and digested with trypsin at 37°C overnight.

collision_energy.evidence: Peptides were then selected for MS/MS using NCE setting at 28, and the fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500.

enrichment_method.evidence: For the supernatant, BAG3-FLAG was immunopurified with anti-FLAG Magnetic Beads (MCE, HY-K0207).

fragmentation_method.evidence: Peptides were then selected for MS/MS using NCE setting at 28, and the fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500.

ionization_type.evidence: The peptides were subjected to an NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q ExactiveTM Plus (Thermo) coupled online to the UPLC.

labeling.evidence: inferred: The resulting MS/MS data were processed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Q ExactiveTM Plus (Thermo) coupled online to the UPLC.
